notes.title: Belated Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Belated Happy New years! I some managed to get the swineflu for the holidays, so bit late. Right now I am caught I was hopping to use this winter break in college to get stuff done, but life is fun. Had really nasty case of flu VA doc almost admitted me to hospital I was that close to getting pneumonia. Finally feeling 90% not 100% yet. I am gonna try to proof and edit my store page some more already replaced old screenshot with Kipp's old outfit with new.

I am still recovering though, got few other outstanding IRL things to do, been out commission was sick for 9 days now, that flu was worst I ever got, defiantly getting flu shot next season. But I am gonna do some work, but I got busy schedule starting new classes on 17, still got follow up stuff with VA doc, yearly check up with them as well. Lots fun stuff. So my goals are a little low for right now sorry about that. I am going all in for sure this summer I did most work durring the last summer break.

Still unsure on a release as I want this to be good quality well as much as a first timer can pull off while going to college and dealing with other stuff. At least my PTSD and depression has calmed down a lot going to school has really helped me out. And I hope to have release another news update this month once I proof and clean up the store page.

Again happy new year all, so far this year defiantly seems like its gonna be nicer then last year for me, hope the same is happing for any one who reads this lol. And as always:

notes.title: August News
notes.content:
So I had a ton of misfortune at the start of this month, lots of plumbing issues that took almost two weeks for my landlord to fix kind of brought my whole life to a halt, as I couldn't shower or use the toilet for almost a week straight that was different kind of experience and threw everything out of whack in my life.

Anyways stuff is finally back to some resemblance of order in my life. I starting classes again today, in fact prepping my my stuff now, charging my laptop and what not for class right now. So I got adobe back feel more motivated now summer is done. Plan getting more done I hope but also got more on my plate just I work better with routine of school. With out it I am disability so my routing is "shop Saturday," and that is about it. Really messes up productivity, Now I got have set sleep schedule and got things I can't go "well maybe I do that in a few hours." lol

Plus school is great for this at is were I can talk and get excited about this stuff more, people online kind of see it as a annoying thing I talk about it while going to school for game design people want to talk about this kind of stuff lol. Anyways sorry slowdown I did anticipate that, got creative writing class wich I am hopping me work on my skills, an art class to up my skills with photoshop, and game development class which is probably my hardest class as I got learn coding to make that one work lol.

Hope who ever following this had a good summer and looking forward to posting more real news about my project as this school year progresses.

notes.title: End of July, early August News Update
notes.content:
With August just around the corner, I am getting prepped for productivity to increase again. Defiantly looking forward to getting my student license of adobe again, I almost bought another art class with it starting August 23rd, which means free till June license again. Nothing much happened. I redid one char design; her old outfit was a bit much; joys of using premade commercial assets, most the outfits for females are made for pin-up calendars, more or less.

Kipps new look, the last one, was way too BDSM for my liking more of a placeholder; I love her new look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42613454/cf9a288b079b4a811cbb32ef2fbdbb1cd65dcb20.png[/img]

Minus, I have been messing, learning the 3d program more, and improving with RPG Maker MZ. For instance, I made this while experimenting with chars. I reached for the game CG.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42613454/ce81ed8048a86dd8f7bda9904ab0137f9b1a4bce.png[/img]
Friendly, fun, inspirational image, and once I get adobe back, I will probably be retexturing that sign at some point as an experiment with the 3d render program for other updates, as well as changing out poses and swapping around chars as the game continues.

But to sum it up, subsequent months' productivity should go back up; I did way more on this when I was in college than in summer break. Plus, that adobe license will significantly help me; everything on the store page I edited with Krita is not a lousy program, but I know adobe better; plus, I miss adobe illustrator. But yeah can't have to wait till the end of the next post. Anything good? Not sure the license will kick back in. I already started paying for classes this month, But no art class till the 23rd. But at any rate, I hope you guys had a fun summer; defiantly to heat is going away.

notes.title: Were Live and Public!
notes.content:
Yes, it's life! Alright, this is the first of, I hope, many status updates on the progress. Right now, I have the plot worked out, main chars, and a working tech demo. I am still far from full release and intend to be out as a full, not EA release. I am very excited; I know it's just an RPG Maker game, but as someone with PTSD who struggles in real life, I feel for this game and want to make it right.

The following steps for me are to keep working on the game and get it polished enough for its first short teaser trailer. I have some issues about why this game is so important to me, so I am taking this one step at a time—but hoping to keep anyone who follows this page in the loop with updates at least once a month. The biggest issue with that is my anxiety had it mapped out for the next three steps, and getting this page live, and the public was next on the list, making fear go crazy as I tried to skip ahead to my next step of getting this game ready for her first trailer.

Thanks for checking this out; I'm not sure how many people I can captivate with what I got here now; sure, I will be doing a lot of work in the coming months to improvise this page and the game itself. So here is hoping anyone reading this will be at the finish line when I get this game ready for release, which now has no set date. As I said, I don't want to skimp on this low-budget first game ever, sure, but I don't have to rush it out.
